sentinel_policy: Required axes may not be blank. Mature live route axes may not use generic not-specific or no-specific sentinels for floor risk, market structure, delivery channel, burden mechanic, rights affected, remedy type, anti-pattern, or review trigger; use a concrete route classifier or document an explicit exemption.

families.tax_administration_access: Filing, refund, payment, notice, correction, appeal, taxpayer service, and private-rail access routes.
families.cross_border_reporting: International information reporting, withholding, treaty, apportionment, tariff, and cross-border coordination routes.
families.controller_ai: AI controller, model-assisted administration, artificial personhood, and public-input reciprocity routes.
families.public_finance_core: General tax-design grammar, rate/base/proceeds, scorecard, review, and fiscal transparency routes.
families.wealth_property_rent: Land, housing, wealth, inheritance, rent, landlord/tenant, and property-location routes.
families.labor_care_benefits: Labor, platform work, care, family, retirement, long-term care, education, and worker-benefit routes.
families.environment_climate_commons: Climate, environmental justice, water, oceans, critical minerals, resource, transportation, and ecological commons routes.
families.financial_system_risk: Financial guarantees, insurance, pensions, digital assets, creditors, systemic risk, and market-contract routes.
families.legal_enforcement_penalty: Penalties, sanctions, courts, forfeiture, supervision, enforcement, whistleblower, and misconduct routes.
families.public_procurement_industrial_policy: Procurement, subsidies, public research, industrial policy, defense, stockpiles, and public-upside routes.
families.regulated_networks_platforms: Telecom, spectrum, digital gatekeepers, app stores, cloud, payment networks, ad markets, and other bottleneck-network routes.
families.release_integrity_currentness: Archive release integrity, source-currentness, cube lifecycle, and regression-harness routes.
families.social_floor_public_services: Agriculture, food, health, disability, immigration/asylum, public health, municipal finance, tribal sovereignty, and essential services routes.

source_currentness_policy: source_currentness_refs mark volatile legal/operational/data-projection anchors and require source_currentness_claims; broad source citations must not be promoted to currentness refs.
remedy_profile_policy: Every route record must have one remedy profile in docs/00-meta/remedy-profiles.json; remedy labels must state default move, blocked move, guardrails, escalation trigger, source-currentness linkage, and proceeds-integrity posture.
case_contract_policy: Every golden case must have a case contract with expected routes, route-backed flags, valid raw axes, remedy-profile obligations, sources, and must-not answers.

policy_action_profile_policy.reason: The instrument axis records labels; policy-action profiles classify the institutional move and block tax/fee/mandate/no-go category mistakes.

actor_accountability_profile_policy.reason: Subject and incidence axes do not identify who must act. Actor-accountability profiles distinguish primary accountable actor, secondary actors, burden bearers, beneficiaries, bottlenecks, non-responsible conduits, public fallback duties, and evidence requirements.

axis_hygiene_policy: Live route records may not use generic not-specific sentinels. Anti-pattern and review-trigger axes should use reusable operational buckets once a route-specific phrase does not add regression value beyond the case-contract layer. Rev0309 blocks tax_administration_access route records from using generic anti_pattern=rent_extraction; they must name the specific access, refund, contest, record, or fallback failure. Rev0310 additionally blocks legal_enforcement_penalty route records from using generic anti_pattern=rent_extraction, public-channel-only delivery, burden_mechanic=legal_risk_transfer, or remedy_type=waiver where seizure, privilege, willfulness, bounty, probation-debt, or contest mechanics are available. Rev0311 additionally blocks labor_care_benefits route records from using generic anti_pattern=rent_extraction, burden_mechanic=legal_risk_transfer, or public-channel-only delivery where status, care-load, credential, pension, childcare, long-term-care, or worker-benefit mechanics are available. Rev0312 additionally blocks environment_climate_commons route records from using generic anti_pattern=rent_extraction, anti_pattern=compliance_theater, delivery_channel=public_channel, burden_mechanic=price_pass_through, burden_mechanic=legal_risk_transfer, or remedy_type=community_benefit where load, water, offset, biodiversity, disaster, mobility, fishery, minerals, port, cumulative-burden, prefunding, or insolvency mechanics are available. Rev0313 additionally blocks financial_system_risk route records from using generic anti_pattern=rent_extraction, anti_pattern=public_loss_private_upside, anti_pattern=compliance_theater, delivery_channel=platform_account, burden_mechanic=legal_risk_transfer, burden_mechanic=fee_surcharge, remedy_type=clawback, or remedy_type=disclosure where guarantee, reserve, custody, de-risking, fiscal-risk, insurance-backstop, event-contract, priority, or policyholder-surplus mechanics are available. Rev0314 additionally blocks wealth_property_rent and public_procurement_industrial_policy routes from using generic rent_extraction, compliance/access-theater, public-loss/private-upside, price-pass-through, deferral, or clawback labels where valuation, liquidity, registry, site-rent, subsidy-condition, stockpile, patent-access, or classified-procurement mechanics are visible.
axis_vocabulary_compression_policy: Rev0305 extends compression gates beyond anti_pattern/review_trigger to the live route base, instrument, and proof_posture axes. Route records should use controlled bucket values there; case contracts may retain sharper scenario flags.
prose_bloat_policy: Rev0306 keeps actor-accountability JSON authoritative and requires route memos to use compact Accountability capsule sections instead of repeated six-row accountability-map tables. Rev0307 requires public_finance_core route memos to use Failure-mode and Recalibration trigger capsules backed by cube anti_pattern/review_trigger axes instead of long local taxonomies. Rev0308 requires controller_ai route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy controller Anti-patterns, change-trigger, and Accountability map sections are blocked. Rev0309 requires tax_administration_access route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy tax-administration Anti-patterns, change-trigger, and Accountability map sections are blocked. Rev0310 requires legal_enforcement_penalty route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy legal-enforcement Anti-patterns and change-trigger sections are blocked. Rev0311 requires labor_care_benefits route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy labor/care Anti-patterns, Anti-pattern definitions, and change-trigger sections are blocked. Rev0312 requires environment_climate_commons route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy environment Anti-patterns, Anti-pattern definitions, and change-trigger sections are blocked. Rev0313 requires financial_system_risk route memos to use Failure-mode, Recalibration trigger, and Accountability capsules backed by cube axes and actor-accountability profiles; legacy financial Anti-patterns, Anti-pattern definitions, Three anti-patterns, and change-trigger sections are blocked. Rev0314 requires wealth/property/rent and procurement/industrial-policy route memos to use Failure-mode and Recalibration trigger capsules backed by cube axes while preserving their Accountability capsules.
disposition_synthesis_policy: Answer emission must not stop at candidate or precedence order; it must produce a checked disposition packet preserving hard blocks, default moves, actors, currentness checks, quantitative/model gaps, and cannot-finalize conditions.

decision_adapter_policy.rule: Final dispositions must expose current-law refresh, jurisdiction-scope, protected-floor delivery, no-go threshold, and quantitative-model adapter requirements before implementation.
